newsitem.title: UK: Soymeal plummets on UK meals and feeds market.
newsitem.headline: Soymeal plummets on UK meals and feeds market.

text.p: High protein soymeal prices plummeted on the UK meals and feeds market on Tuesday morning.

Ex-mill sellers were as much as six stg a tonne down following the collapse of soybean futures in Chicago on Monday after news that the USDA had left its soybean carryover figure unchanged at 125 million bushels.
"We have seen some very keen sellers this morning, but buyers are taking their time," said one broker.
Ex-store high-pro prices and Brazilian 48s were down a similar amount.
Rapemeal started the day unchanged ex-mill Erith while the Liverpool and Hull mills were one stg lower.
Most other sectors of the market were unchanged.
